Guides / Install Motion Design

Project setup · checked 14 November 2026

Install Motion Design.

Give your coding agent reusable guidance for timing, easing and interface feedback. Choose your agent, copy one folder, then try it.

You need existing Codex CLI/IDE or local Claude Code access and a project folder. The skill is MIT-licensed; your agent subscription and usage allowances are separate.

Step 01

Download and unzip

Download Motion Design skill

Extract the ZIP. Keep the complete motion-design folder: SKILL.md, its reference Markdown and LICENSE. Read these before use. No code installer is needed.

Ready when: you have completed this step and checked the result before continuing.

If this step does not work

Recheck the requirements and the exact file or account you selected. Keep your original unchanged; use the guide's fix or undo advice.

Step 02

Choose your project location

Inside the project you open in your agent, create the folders for your chosen path and copy motion-design into skills. Enable hidden-file display if needed. Do not overwrite an existing skill; keep a backup first.

Codex CLI or IDE

.agents/skills/motion-design/SKILL.md

Local Claude Code

.claude/skills/motion-design/SKILL.md

Choose one path. These are project folders, not your personal home folder. Avoid an extra nested motion-design/motion-design directory.

Ready when: you have completed this step and checked the result before continuing.

If this step does not work

Recheck the requirements and the exact file or account you selected. Keep your original unchanged; use the guide's fix or undo advice.

Step 03

Check that your agent finds it

Open the same project. In Codex, use /skills or type $motion-design; restart Codex if it is missing. In Claude Code, look for /motion-design. If absent, recheck the exact file path and start a new local session. Organisation settings may restrict discovery.

Ready when: you have completed this step and checked the result before continuing.

If this step does not work

Recheck the requirements and the exact file or account you selected. Keep your original unchanged; use the guide's fix or undo advice.

Step 04

Try one small task

Use the motion-design skill to improve loading, success and retry feedback in a separate copy of my sample form. Read its relevant references first. Preserve keyboard access and support reduced motion. Explain what you changed and what you checked.

Get the practice form and checks. Confirm the agent identifies the skill before accepting its result.

Ready when: you have completed this step and checked the result before continuing.

If this step does not work

Recheck the requirements and the exact file or account you selected. Keep your original unchanged; use the guide's fix or undo advice.

Remove it

Delete only the copied motion-design folder in your chosen project skill location; restore your backup if applicable. This does not undo generated code changes.

Sources, licence and verification limits
